The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right, leaning forward to push her hands against the shoulder of the man in the black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1). The man (R1) stands on the right, facing away from her. The background features dark room dividers and white walls under bright overhead lighting.
